facts.fact: UNFPA DR Congo reports a joint United Nations pilot project under way in one commune, Masina in Kinshasa, to digitalise civil-status events at its municipal civil-status office, which handles more than 2,000 births and 200 marriages a month; no other office is named (the pilot's own dates are not given: dated to publication).
facts.system: digitalisation des faits de l'état civil (DHIS2), commune de Masina

facts.fact: UNFPA states that the Masina pilot aims to automate the collection and management of data on births, marriages and deaths, and that deploying DHIS2 in the commune 'will' systematise the registration of births, marriages and deaths and the issue of civil-status acts: stated as the aim, not as events already registered digitally (dated to publication).
facts.system: digitalisation des faits de l'état civil (DHIS2), commune de Masina

facts.fact: UNFPA states that the Masina pilot is executed by four United Nations entities (UNICEF, the UN Joint Human Rights Office, UNHCR and UNFPA), with the Institut National de la Statistique giving technical support; no ministry is named as running it (dated to publication).
facts.system: digitalisation des faits de l'état civil (DHIS2), commune de Masina

facts.fact: UNFPA states that the Masina pilot is financed by the United Nations Joint SDG Fund; no sum and no domestic budget line is given (dated to publication).
facts.system: digitalisation des faits de l'état civil (DHIS2), commune de Masina

facts.fact: UNFPA states that the National Civil Registration Strategy drawn up in 2020 with World Bank financing has still to be adopted by the National Assembly, and says the government 'should' have it adopted; it also names a Plan national de réforme de l'état civil among documents produced by the reform begun in 2010, without date or saying it names the system (dated to publication).
facts.system: digitalisation des faits de l'état civil (DHIS2), commune de Masina

facts.fact: On 18 August 2025 UNFPA reported the first pilot of digital civil registration, in the commune of Masina, Kinshasa, as under way, with DHIS2 being deployed there.
facts.system: digitalisation des faits de l'état civil (DHIS2), commune de Masina
